title: Root multiplicity of a product of polynomials is additive
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $T$ an indeterminate, $K[T]$ the polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring], $c\in K$, and for $P\in K[T]$ let $m_c(P)$ be the multiplicity of $c$ as a root of $P$ [def-weil-root-multiplicity]. For nonzero $P,Q\in K[T]$ one has $m_c(PQ)=m_c(P)+m_c(Q)$.

source.place: ## Proof, second paragraph: the order of vanishing of $P_i$ at $T=c^{-1}$ read off from the factorization $P_i=\prod_r(1-\alpha_{i,r}T)$, which uses that root multiplicities add over products; no proof is given there
